ModMetaData.name: RimWorld Test Harness
ModMetaData.author: Joof
ModMetaData.description:
Dev-only automation harness. Loads a scripted scenario (save file, tile/season/time, scripted actions), runs numeric probes and/or screenshots against another mod under test, and writes a JSON report. Not intended for normal play — enabled only by the Runner scripts under Runner/ when running an automated test pass.
Not published to Workshop.
